obs: Merrick Et Al. v. N. W. Halsey & Company Et Al., and the Weis Fibre Container Corporation
“a remedy in the courts is explicitly given, and if it were not given it would necessarily be implied.”

“In the absence of any available administrative remedy, the right here asserted, to a remedy for breach of the statutory duty … is of judicial cognizance.”

“For the present command there is no mode of enforcement other than resort to the courts, whose jurisdiction and duty to afford a remedy for a breach of statutory duty are left unaffected.”
“the statutory provisions which are in issue are stated in the form of commands.”
